title: GP Onboarding Workflow API
auth: Admin session for mutations and dashboard; doctor magic-link or authenticated portal for doctor task updates. Public EOI remains separate.

enforcement: POST .../gates requires reviewerId, reviewerName, decision, rationale
Transition to live only via gate decision approve_advance on stage go_live
EOI score endpoints cannot call gate approve
Notification webhooks cannot mutate gate_approved or live
Server rejects gate payloads that claim system/auto as reviewerId

endpoints.summary: Return published workflow definition (stages, tasks, transitions)
List onboarding cases for dashboard (filter by status, stage)
Create case from enquiry or link existing EOI
Case detail: stages, tasks, gates, notifications
Update a single task status (doctor or admin by owner)
sideEffects: May set stage to ready_for_gate when required tasks done

endpoints.summary: Human gate decision — only path to approve stage advance or go-live

body.rationale: Documents sighted; sessions agreed; orientation complete.

responses.201: Gate event recorded; case/stage status updated
responses.400: Missing human fields, invalid transition, or incomplete required tasks

endpoints.summary: Human status change for pause / withdraw / decline (also via gates where applicable)
Computed readiness checklist for go-live review (informational)
endpoints.note: Completeness % is advisory. Release still requires gate.
